candidate_policy.cold: identical constant-state/zero-control all lanes, selected with original finite/merit selector
candidate_policy.warm: shift latest selected optimizer output by current solve-start time minus previous solve-start time; re-anchor actual measured state; lane0 identical nominal, B16 lanes1:16 fresh perturbations
candidate_policy.rng: numpy.default_rng(SeedSequence([20260925, pair_id, 30000])); canonical preflight uses pair_id0; B1 consumes no proposal draws; save actual coefficients and input candidates each call
candidate_policy.construction: Preserve original three cosine modes times s^2, amplitudes .02/.05/.1 rad, analytic q/v/a, nominal ABA acceleration plus perturbation mapped by RNEA; use new N32 prediction duration; no goal/IK/collision conditioning
candidate_policy.rho: reset before every call including bootstrap; adapt within solve
candidate_policy.dual: reset once per episode; retain native per-physical-slot duals; no winner-dual copy or permutation
candidate_policy.selection: Use existing assess: finite full optimized plan, finite final_merit, finite nominal-feedback RK4 prefix from frozen solve-start state; choose min(final_merit,lane). Physical bounds diagnostic only; no arrival-state selector or live force selector
candidate_policy.selection_prefix_s: min(0.03, 8.0 - solve_start_time_s), independent of measured solve duration
candidate_policy.force: force_estimator=None; zero6D force in every lane

clock.paid_scope: perf_counter around public controller.solver.solve(state, reference, candidates) only; includes wrapper and current reference-only NativeCapture shim work inside call
clock.native_units: native returned microseconds; retain unchanged and convert to ms via /1000; never drive plant
clock.unpaid_bootstrap: First selected cold solve activates at t=0, retain wall/native timing but do not charge plant; execute one nominal0.03s prefix; this is not F01ab unrelated CUDA warmup
clock.alignment: Freeze feedback state/reference/candidates at solve start. Old active plan plays for current measured wall seconds. Returned selected plan starts at u0 only on arrival. Next feedback starts immediately at arrival, without adding nominal wait
clock.control_origin: sample by plant_time-active_plan_activation_time, separately from optimizer solve-start origin
clock.warm_origin: current_feedback_time-previous_optimizer_solve_start_time; includes bootstrap origin0; never use activation age
clock.integration: RK4 maximum0.003s, split at active-control knot boundaries and exact fractional interval/task remainder; no deferred remainder
clock.plan_end: packed terminal state has no control; hold u[N-2] beyond horizon
clock.terminal: single goal per episode; clip plant replay at8s only; full requested wall duration/arrival retained; completed late output discarded. Check gates after nominal startup or paid interval before activating output; reached old-plan task discards output too
clock.no_winner: retain all outputs and eligibility failures; for completed paid feedback calls execute old-plan interval before stopping for no eligible output; record task gates separately; bootstrap with no eligible output cannot activate or execute
clock.exception: native/wrapper/recorder/assessment/plant exception preserves partial evidence and holds family; do not manufacture remaining plant replay or a scientific pass

clock.claim_conflict: Accepted revision allows a declared timing scope. This BB pays public solver-wrapper-wall only; portfolio/diagnostic/recording costs are separately measured and excluded from plant time. No full Python pipeline latency-paid claim.
